value.rationale: Cyclic-triad counts are a standard transitivity diagnostic for random paired comparisons. Exact excess kurtosis changes sign sharply at eight vertices and approaches 12/n, identifying a nontrivial finite-sample direction of Gaussian departure. The signed-four-cycle census with cancellation at n=7 gives a structural explanation rather than a mere enumerated small value.
